sketches.mechanism: The Maybe monad's fmap over Nothing — applying any transformation to Nothing still yields Nothing
sketches.resonance: No matter what you try to give someone who is absent, the absence remains unchanged.
sketches.draft:
gift :: a -> Maybe b -> Maybe a
gift _ Nothing  = Nothing
gift x (Just _) = Just x

main = print (gift 42 Nothing)

sketches.mechanism: A LEFT JOIN where the right table has no matching rows — the result fills with NULLs for every column you hoped to find
sketches.resonance: You can reach for someone who was supposed to be there, but every field comes back empty.

sketches.mechanism: The Elvis operator (?:) — a fallback value used only when the left side is null, meaning you only arrive at the alternative when the original is gone
sketches.resonance: You were never the first choice; you exist only because what came before you was null.
